-- Dim Customer
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id 
WHERE t.name = 'DimCustomers' AND s.name = 'gold' )

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimCustomers
WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'DimCustomers',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
AS
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CustomerID) AS DimCustomers,
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    CustomerEmail
FROM(
    SELECT 
    DISTINCT 
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    CustomerEmail
FROM silver.silverTable 
) AS t

-- Dim Product
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id 
    WHERE t.name = 'DimProducts' AND s.name = 'gold' )
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimProducts
WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'DimProducts',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
AS
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ProductID) AS DimProducts,
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductCategory
FROM(
    SELECT 
    DISTINCT 
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductCategory
FROM silver.silverTable 
) AS t


-- Dim Region
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id 
    WHERE t.name = 'DimRegions' AND s.name = 'gold' )
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimRegions
WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'DimRegions',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
AS
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RegionID) AS DimRegions,
    RegionID,
    RegionName,
    Country
FROM(
    SELECT 
    DISTINCT 
    RegionID,
    RegionName,
    Country
FROM silver.silverTable 
) AS t

SELECT * FROM silver.silverTable

-- Dim Order
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id 
    WHERE t.name = 'DimOrders' AND s.name = 'gold' )
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.DimOrders
WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'DimOrders',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
AS
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY OrderID) AS DimOrders,
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    CustomerEmail,
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductCategory,
    RegionID,
    RegionName,
    Country
FROM(
    SELECT 
    DISTINCT 
    OrderID,
    OrderDate,
    CustomerID,
    CustomerName,
    CustomerEmail,
    ProductID,
    ProductName,
    ProductCategory,
    RegionID,
    RegionName,
    Country
FROM silver.silverTable 
) AS t
